name: Apple M3 Pro (14-core GPU bin)
memory_bandwidth_basis: 150 GB/s is the figure the llama.cpp #4167 scoreboard prints for the 14-core GPU M3 Pro, and it is Apple's published unified-memory bandwidth for M3 Pro (same bandwidth as the 18-core bin). Filed separately from local-apple-m3-pro because that record describes the 18-core GPU configuration, and the 14-core bin measures a different GPU.
notes: The binned M3 Pro: 11-core CPU (5P+6E) and 14-core GPU, 150 GB/s, up to 36 GB unified memory (14-inch MacBook Pro, late 2023). local-apple-m3-pro is the 18-core GPU / 12-core CPU bin of the same die and is NOT this record. Same published bandwidth, fewer GPU cores; the F16 column of the scoreboard is blank for this bin and is not filed. memory_bus_bit is null; not back-computed from bandwidth.
